text:
mike: deploybot auto-paused the release window. multiple CI jobs failed after cache eviction during parallel e2e run. holding promotion.
tara: logs show `cache restore miss` + downstream integration flakiness (e2e-suite:payment-flow failing 4/4).
sre-oncall: eviction triggered by nightly GC hitting shared build-cache. Runners started slow and pipelined tasks piled up.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion halted at step=postsubmit-e2e; last-known-good=docker.redwood/inference:2026-03-26-cd1234. To continue manually: `deploybot promote --to-image cd1234 --force --reason "pin-after-cache-eviction"`
lucy: PMs want the patch today. Options: 1) manual pin to last-known-good and run targeted smoke tests, 2) rerun CI after increasing cache TTL and reducing parallelism (adds ~30m).
pm-omar: prefer pin + follow-up mitigation so customers get the fix. Add a release note explaining the manual pin.
tara: i'll run smoke harness if we pin. Also will add a CI preflight to fail fast on cache-restore miss.
sre-oncall: will revert aggressive GC TTL and add staggered cache warmers for critical builds. Opening infra ticket INF-1200.
mike: tara, can you run `deploybot promote --to-image cd1234 --reason "manual-pin-due-to-cache-evict"` and run smoke?
tara: running now.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. canary rollout to staging at 10%. health checks enabled.
sre-oncall: infra changes deploying to staging to prevent recurrence.
deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded in staging. prod cut remains manual pending PM approval.
pm-omar: documented: "Prod cut pinned to previous stable image cd1234 due to CI cache eviction causing e2e failures; follow-ups: revert cache TTL, CI preflight on cache restore, INF-1200."
mike: scheduling 30-min postmortem after prod cut decision. closing thread for now.
